notes.title: Patch 0.4.2
notes.notes: Bug fixes, visual upgrades, ghost-of-player-from-highscores upgrades.

notes.title: Patch Version 0.4.0
notes.notes: New font! Plus streamlined beta for more of a vertical slice. UI updates, collectible coins/new collectibles added, ghost system refined, plenty of bugfixes, maybe more bugs introduced :O. Good dodging!

notes.title: Patch 0.3.1 bugfixes
notes.notes: Minor bugfixes, mainly being Mac fixes so the game runs on Mac.

notes.title: Update to 0.3, Map 3 released
notes.notes: Hey everyone, similar to last update, we've got Map 3 with Easy and Medium versions out so it's "complete" except for any changes we'll be making from feedback on them. Good luck and happy dodging!

notes.title: Version 0.2 released! Map 2 complete, NEED FEEDBACK
notes.notes:
Completed the Easy and Medium versions of Map 2, as well as tweaked the Hard version that was previously testable to be even harder. Look for feedback on whether or not easy and medium feel appropriately tweaked and if there are any frustrating or confusing parts. Good luck! Patches with tweaks of Map 2 will come shortly.

Also, there is a rudimentary ghost system. If you complete a map, the next time you play it, your ghost will appear when you cross the starting line and retrace your best time's steps. We hope to expand this so you can activate anyone else's ghost so you can race someone else's best time.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.7
notes.notes: Leaderboards now tell you how many times someone was hit and has died, giving special colors to those who complete levels deathless or even hitless. Also minor bugfixes.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.6
notes.notes: Added a map preview and some more legibility to the highscores in the level menu.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.5
notes.notes: Fixes to the new character sprite and hitbox opacity sliders, shadows, and hitboxes.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.4
notes.notes: Added hitbox/character sprite opacity sliders, as well as saving them and volume slider's locally so you don't need to set them every time. Some UI changes as well.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.3
notes.notes: More trapdoor optimization (hopefully for good) and fixed options resolution menu to save preferences.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2
notes.notes:
Improving trap door efficiency to reduce lag, thanks to Dominator088 in the Discord for pointing it out!

Also, added an FPS counter to help quantify any lag.

notes.title: patch 0.1.1
notes.notes: Added a discord button so folks can provide direct feedback!

notes.title: Patch 0.1
notes.notes: Initial beta build for testing. Have fun dodging!
